project_overview.background_context: Gaussian Splatting dashboard with on-device NPU/TPU acceleration via WebNN and WebGPU viewer.

rules: Use #0A0A0A pure obsidian for the base app background to make the 3D elements pop.
Use surface #141414 for control panels with 1px outline #2D2D2D.
Primary #DC143C is ONLY for primary actions (e.g., 'Start Processing', 'Export').
Copper effects are reserved for data/processing states (progress bars, active states, NPU active).

spacing_and_layout.grid_structure: Dense, highly structured panels. Main viewer takes col-span-2 or col-span-3. Left/right panels for settings and uploads take col-span-1.
spacing_and_layout.spacing_scale: p-4, p-6 for panels. gap-4 or gap-6 for dashboard items.
spacing_and_layout.alignment: Strict left alignment for data and settings. Central alignment for the viewer canvas.

surface_strategies.panels: Flat solid background (#141414) with crisp 1px borders (#2D2D2D), no heavy drop shadows, mimicking a technical command center.
surface_strategies.floating_controls: Glassmorphism (bg-[#141414]/70, backdrop-blur-xl, border-[#2D2D2D]) inside the 3D viewer.
surface_strategies.active_processing: Tracing Beam effect using the copper gradient to surround the processing panel or NPU status.

uploader.design: Large dashed border using #8A8A8A, turning to #B87333 on drag over. Dark background #0A0A0A. Prominent 'Drag & Drop' typography.

npu_status_widget.design: Small tech-focused card. Use green/copper dots for 'Active' status. Mono font for metrics.

processing_pipeline.design: Linear progress bar using copper base (#B87333) with shimmer animation during processing.

viewer_3d.design: Massive central area. Black background. Has floating action buttons on bottom/top corners for reset camera, toggle wireframe, etc.

export_controls.design: Secondary styling (#262626 bg, #F5F5F5 text) with crisp borders.

animation_and_motion.hover_states: Crisp transition: background lightens slightly, border changes to copper (#B87333) or crimson (#DC143C).
animation_and_motion.processing_state: Pulsing/shimmering copper gradients to indicate NPU workload.
animation_and_motion.transitions: Fast and snappy (0.2s) - no bouncy physics. This is a pro tool.

icons_and_assets.usage: Use technical, sharp icons. (e.g., Cpu, UploadCloud, Box, Download, Settings, Activity)

viewer_placeholder_bg.description: Abstract ethereal cloud to use as an empty state background inside the 3D Viewer.

copper_texture_accent.description: Subtle concentric copper spirals texture. Can be used as a mask or very low opacity background for the NPU processing card.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure pure white (#F5F5F5) is used on pure black (#0A0A0A) for maximum APCA contrast.
accessibility_and_testing.testing: All interactive elements MUST have explicit data-testid attributes.
